examples: Down is the reverse of up.
I thought she was happy, but the reverse was true.
The reverse side of the coin has a bird.

related.def: Able to be turned inside out or backward.

examples: Let us review our spelling words.
I will review my notes.
We reviewed the story.

more.def: To look over or study something again so that you remember it.
examples: We reviewed our spelling words before the test.
She reviewed her notes on the plane.
The class reviewed the story before writing about it.

easy.def: Writing about a book or movie you saw.
examples: I wrote a review of the book.
The movie got a good review.
The review was short.

more.def: A report that tells what someone thinks of a book, movie or show.
examples: The newspaper gave the movie a good review.
I read a review of the book before I bought it.
Her review of the restaurant said the soup was the best.

easy.def: A big change in how people live.
examples: The invention was a revolution.
The computer started a revolution.
The revolution changed life.

more.def: A great and sudden change in how people think, work or live.
examples: The invention of the computer started a revolution.
The people made a revolution to change the government.
The industrial revolution brought machines to factories.
The wheel makes one revolution.
The earth makes one revolution around the sun in a year.
The wheel made ten revolutions.

more.def: One full turn around a point or a circle.
examples: The earth makes one revolution around the sun each year.
The wheel made ten revolutions each minute.
The moon makes a revolution around the earth in about a month.
A revolutionary idea.
The phone was revolutionary.
A revolutionary machine.

more.def: Completely new and changing the way things are done.
examples: The telephone was a revolutionary invention.
She had a revolutionary idea for a car.
The new machine was revolutionary.

easy.def: A nice thing you get for doing something good.
examples: I got a sticker as a reward.
My dog gets a treat as a reward.
The reward was a gold star.

more.def: Something given to you for doing something good or helpful.
examples: The family offered a reward for finding their lost cat.
As a reward for their hard work, the class got extra recess.
The reward for finishing the hike was a wonderful view.
I rewrite my story.
She rewrote the note.
He rewrote the poem.

more.def: To write something again to make it better.
examples: I rewrote my story to fix the ending.
She rewrote the note more neatly.
He rewrote the poem three times.
